unit.name: upstream-merge
unit.rows: the whole run of fifteen probes against the upstream head merged, by function, once the merged tree's tests pass
unit.more: and then "sh scripts/check.sh wasm" and "sh scripts/check.sh bench" (a merge brings engine, suite and arms); the cost group is not in this gate: the builder's whole run against the upstream head merged is in the change's directory, read its EXIT line and its totals. The tree is a merge in progress (.git/MERGE_HEAD): step 1's "only what the unit's section says it changes" is everything upstream brings and the resolutions; the one commit is the merge commit (git add -A, then git commit -F with the message file), and its subject names what was merged, in the manner of git log --merges --oneline -5
unit.brief: THE WHOLE BRIEF IS A FILE: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-supdb/2fecfb3d-3630-50b2-b9c5-2a19705f39b6/scratchpad/plan/build/M1/brief.txt. Read all of it before anything else and again before you answer; it is this change's section, and what follows here is only its outline. The owner asked for upstream to be merged again (origin/claude/e-recode-stride-selector-g5f6hl, last merged at 9bfc4362). This change is one merge of upstream's head into this branch and one merge commit, made so that every gate this branch has built holds over the merged tree: fetch once and fix the sha; git merge --no-commit --no-ff (the one exception to rule 9's no checkout over the tree; the tree is a merge in progress until the commit step); resolve, above all the one semantic collision (both sides fixed the same bug, a copy's claim about a partition's records carried across its rewrite, in different shapes: CachedBlock::identity as a u64 here, a bool beside identity_of upstream; one shape stands, chosen on soundness by a check, then on the count against upstream, then on less code); show nothing of either side was lost; answer this branch's gates (the wall, the door, the cost entries, the workflows' test, G1-6's removal of residency and advice by address) for upstream's new code; say for each of upstream's new mechanisms what it reads and whether a store under a cipher runs it right, with the differential fuzz under a cipher and in the clear beyond the gate's range as the evidence; open every arm of the roster once at the smallest rung (a check, not a timing); count the plain store against the upstream head merged over all fifteen probes, every probe at or under upstream by function; no default changed by this change, no arm removed, no timing taken. How an agent waits, the disk and how reviewers read a merge in progress are in the file.
